corrections_applied.after: a Summoning Railway train was hijacked,
corrections_applied.reason: In the continuing source sentence, the seized 召喚鉄道 is carrying important Imperial figures, who are then taken hostage. English needs the passenger-carrying train to make that contextual metonymy explicit; 'the Summoning Railway was stolen' inaccurately treats the railway itself as the stolen object.

remaining_uncertainties.issue: Summoning Railway remains the project descriptor for 召喚鉄道. The source does not name the train, so the correction uses the descriptor with a lower-case generic vehicle noun.

status: Reviewer corrections applied; names normalized afterward. Whole-resource acceptance pending.
